sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Floral Cluster Nath – Sparkling White Stone Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Complete your festive look with this stunning gold-toned floral cluster nath. Featuring shimmering white stones and a delicate drop charm, this high-fashion piece is a true showstopper. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after use.
